text.p: Syncor International Corp on Tuesday said it has completed its acquisition of all the assets related to Golden Pharmaceuticals Inc's Iodine-123 business.
Iodine-123 is a nuclear medicine product used to diagnose thyroid disorders, and it is distributed nationally by Syncor International.

Included in the acquisition is the new drug application for Iodine-123 capsules, the building that contains the manufacturing facility for Iodine-123 capsules and all the equipment related to the iodine business.
The new entity will be the manufacturing arm for Syncor International and will operate under the name of Syncor Pharmaceuticals Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Syncor.
Also included in the acquisition are several inactive drug applications for which Syncor is currently evaluating potential business opportunities.
